reviews.comment: The class was guest lectures so she is not the one teaching. Very caring and wanted us to get the most out of this class. I thought the class was informative and the work was very little except for one big project/paper. Take this class if you need an extra biology hour.

she's meh. she's a really nice lady and the work is beyond easy. you could get away with doing the hw's in 3 minutes tops. but the class is boring all the presenters are medical device and sales reps. very rarely was it anything anyone in the class was into to. easy A fs but only 1 credit and boring

Don't waste your time. The early half is ok and informative, but you can probably go to a resume workshop and get similar advice and feedback. The second half is presentations by professionals. Some were very insightful, but most were just people in biology related sales careers (which is a valid career, but I wanted more variety and advice)
